_comment: Hesitation sounds speech-to-text writes down. Matched as whole words, ignoring case, accents and repeated letters ('Εεε,' = 'ε', 'ummm' = 'um'). 'anywhere' are dropped wherever they appear; 'leading' are real words used as fillers, dropped only at the start of a turn. Not here on purpose: 'mhm', 'uh-huh', 'hı hı' (they mean yes), 'ναι', 'evet', 'yani', 'λοιπόν'.
